name: item-status
author: lumine-code
description: Show the active pane item's path and the cursor position in the status bar.
backgroundTips: You can copy the active item's path by clicking it in the status bar, or shift-click to copy it relative to the project.
You can open the go to line dialog by clicking the cursor position in the status bar.

showFileInfo.title: Show File Info
showFileInfo.description: Show the tile with the active pane item's path, or its title when it has no path.

showEditorPosition.title: Show Editor Position
showEditorPosition.description: Show the tile with the cursor position of the active text editor.

template.title: Template
template.description: Select the information shown in the editor position tile. Choose `Custom` to use the template below.
enum: Row and Column, Lines and Chars
template.default: Row and Column, Lines and Chars

custom.title: Custom Template
custom.description: Liquid template used when `Template` is `Custom`. Variables: `start.row`, `start.col` (where the selection begins, or the cursor when nothing is selected), `end.row`, `end.col` (where the cursor is; equals `start` with no selection), `lines`, `chars` (selected line and character counts), and `n` (number of cursors). `start` and `end` follow the selection's direction. Supports tags such as `{% if chars %}-{{ end.row }}:{{ end.col }}{% endif %}`.
custom.default: {{ start.row }}:{{ start.col }}{% if chars %}-{{ end.row }}:{{ end.col }}{% endif %}{% if n > 1 %} #{{ n }}{% endif %}
